projectDescription: A story-driven, whitelist RedM frontier roleplay community set in the Wild West, circa 1900, where players build character-led narratives through immersive voice-driven scenes, lasting consequences, and a tight-knit 18+ player community.
keyFeatures: Story-driven frontier roleplay built on Red Dead Redemption 2 via RedM
Character-led narratives with lasting consequences, relationships, and organic faction dynamics
Whitelist application process ensuring a committed, rules-aware 18+ player community
Structured whitelisted roles for law enforcement, lawyers, and doctors with queue priority perks
Open-to-all frontier livelihoods including ranching, commerce, craftwork, and drifting
Integrated proximity in-game voice chat — no third-party software required
Comprehensive stance and emote command system (/s, /me, /do, /try, /hurt, /tag)
Queue priority system rewarding active whitelisted roles and community contributors
Discord-based ticket system for support, role applications, and rule enforcement
publicApiSurface: /me — describe character action or expression to nearby players
/do — add observable scene detail or describe the surrounding environment
/try — show character attempting an action with uncertain outcome
/hurt — communicate character's visible wounds or pain
/tag — add a visible description of a character attribute
/kys — immediately down character when physically stuck (last resort only)
/s <stancename> — hold a pose or looping animation (e.g. /s sitg, /s leanpostl, /s stand)
J — cycle in-game voice range (Whisper / Normal / Shout)
U — open Hotbar for quick item access
Caps Lock / Middle Mouse Wheel — open radial Interaction Menu
